scope: Credit-class chain client initialization, mint, retirement, balance verification, and batch issuance failure reporting

behavior.rpc_initialization: Provider initialization failures omit RPC endpoint details and suppress the original exception context; issuer-key parsing reports only the exception class.
behavior.mint_and_retirement: Chain operation failures log only the exception class and raise a bounded summary without exposing the provider exception or chained context.
behavior.batch_issuance: Best-effort on-chain sync returns a bounded error summary while preserving the already-verified batch issuance state.
behavior.balance_verification: A failed chain query is explicitly marked failed and cannot be reported as a matching zero balance; the error summary omits provider details.

coverage: secret-bearing RPC initialization errors do not expose endpoint or exception content
secret-bearing mint and retirement failures are redacted from logs and raised summaries
best-effort batch issuance returns a bounded chain-sync failure summary
chain balance outages cannot produce a false matching result, including for zero balances

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked connection, RPC client, and contract

limitations: No live database, RPC endpoint, wallet, or contract was contacted.
This does not establish token/ledger parity or successful transaction delivery on Celo.
